document_title: Deterministic Vehicle Intervention & Secondary Exposure State Machine
epistemic_mandate: A single transient threshold spike (e.g. steering twitch or brake tap) DOES NOT constitute a confirmed causal intervention. All candidate interventions require a PRIMARY_TRIGGER, a SECONDARY_CONFIRMATION, and a MINIMUM_PERSISTENCE_DURATION before advancing state.

PRE_INTERVENTION.description: Vehicle traveling along nominal trajectory; unperturbed kinematics; baseline duration >= 3.0 s.

INTERVENTION_TRIGGERED.description: Initial threshold breach detected at t_intervention_trigger; awaiting persistence confirmation.
INTERVENTION_TRIGGERED.confirmation_rule: Signal must remain above threshold for >= MINIMUM_PERSISTENCE_DURATION (100 ms) and achieve secondary confirmation to become INTERVENTION_ACTIVE; otherwise resets to PRE_INTERVENTION as spurious transient.

INTERVENTION_ACTIVE.description: Confirmed physical intervention underway (braking, swerving, or combined evasive maneuver).
INTERVENTION_ACTIVE.dynamics: Sustained deceleration ax <= -1.5 m/s^2 OR sustained yaw rate |dpsi/dt| >= 12.0 deg/s.

PRIMARY_RISK_RESOLUTION.description: Vehicle clears the primary obstacle clearance envelope (d_primary >= d_clearance) or comes to a controlled stop.

TRAJECTORY_STABILIZATION.description: Post-intervention steering damping and acceleration recovery as vehicle returns to steady heading or remains stopped.

INTERVENTION_COMPLETE.description: Vehicle has fully concluded evasive dynamics.

SECONDARY_EXPOSURE.description: Geometric entry of an actor, proxy, or structural barrier into the vehicle's diverted trajectory corridor.
SECONDARY_EXPOSURE.temporal_horizon_classification: tau = t_secondary_onset - t_intervention_confirmed. If tau <= 2.0s -> INSIDE_CURRENT_ANALYTIC_HORIZON; If tau > 2.0s -> OUTSIDE_CURRENT_ANALYTIC_HORIZON.

POST_OBSERVATION.description: Post-event monitoring window (duration 2.0 s to 10.0 s) capturing full downstream resolution.

primary_trigger.filter: 2nd-order Butterworth low-pass filter (cutoff fc = 10.0 Hz, sample rate fs = 50.0 Hz)

secondary_confirmation.condition: brake_state == TRUE (or brake line pressure >= 5.0 bar)

secondary_confirmation.condition: abs(steering_rate) >= 15.0 deg/s (derived as filtered central derivative of steering_angle)

secondary_exposure_geometric_schema.definition: Secondary exposure is defined PRIMARILY GEOMETRICALLY: an entity intersects the vehicle's dynamic clearance corridor following swerve diversion.

secondary_zone_entry.description: Entity is physically located inside cross-aisle zone polygon.

secondary_corridor_entry.description: Entity intersects the projected 2.0m dynamic vehicle clearance corridor.

eligibility_interpretation.inside_horizon: tau <= 2.0 s -> INSIDE_CURRENT_ANALYTIC_HORIZON. Eligible for full backfire causal evaluation.
eligibility_interpretation.outside_horizon: tau > 2.0 s -> OUTSIDE_CURRENT_ANALYTIC_HORIZON. Package preserved for delayed confounding studies.

strict_epistemic_prohibitions: PROHIBITION 1: Never classify tau > 2.0 s as NO_BACKFIRE (it may be a delayed backfire outside current scope).
PROHIBITION 2: Never classify tau <= 2.0 s as BACKFIRE (it may be an independent coincidental actor).
PROHIBITION 3: Tau establishes temporal eligibility only; it NEVER establishes causality without counterfactual evidence.
